segments.text: Hi, we are Team Alpha and we built a tool that turns meeting notes into tracked action items.
The problem: action items from meetings are lost because nobody owns writing them down.
Our approach uses a small on-device model to extract tasks, then syncs them to your issue tracker.
Here is a live demo: I record a sentence, and the extracted task appears in the web app.
Next steps are calendar integration and a beta with three pilot teams.
